Backoffice.title: Staff backoffice
Backoffice.intro: Browse your assigned organizations or look up an organization by its exact ID. Every search and lookup is audited.
Backoffice.ready: Signed in. Enter an organization ID and case reference.
Backoffice.enrolled: Passkey enrolled. Sign in to continue.
Backoffice.denied: Access unavailable. Check your session and organization permissions, or contact your security administrator.
Backoffice.name: Name
Backoffice.invalid: Enter a valid organization UUID and case reference.
Backoffice.accessNote: Access is limited to your assigned organizations.
Backoffice.lookupDescription: Find an organization by its exact ID. Only details within your assigned scope are returned.
Backoffice.caseHelp: Add a ticket or case reference for the audit record.
Backoffice.caseError: Use 1–80 letters, numbers, periods, underscores, colons or hyphens; start with a letter or number.
Backoffice.overviewDescription: Organization metadata and local seat capacity.
Backoffice.emptyHelp: Sign in, then enter an organization ID and case reference to view its details.
Backoffice.signInDescription: Use your invited staff passkey to access the workspace.
Backoffice.enrollmentHelp: Enter the invitation code provided by your security administrator to register your passkey.
